name: Community — LTX 2.5 (Video Refine, MSR)
author: LiconStudio + Lightricks
description: Re-render any finished clip (MiniMax H3 or otherwise) at up to 1080p with LTX 2.5, holding the faces with Licon's Multi-Subject-Reference IC-LoRA. Drop the clip in Reference Video 1, one to four face pictures in the face slots, and optionally a background plate in the fifth slot, the same layout as the official Multi-Reference preset. The clip is scaled to half the tier, encoded, upsampled 2x by the LTX latent spatial upscaler and refined by the distilled LTX 2.5 with the reference faces prepended, then decoded. The source soundtrack is muxed back untouched. LTX re-renders texture, so expect a crisper, more LTX-looking result than the H3 Video Refine pack; pick this one for sharpness or when a face needs a reference to hold. The prompt must be LTX style, not the H3 brief: one paragraph, '<who> <does what> in <where>, <camera>, <light>'. Requires a HuggingFace API key and one-time acceptance of the LTX 2.5 licence (gated repo); the weights are the same files the LTX 2.5 packs already use.

presets.name: LTX 2.5 Video Refine (Multi-Reference)
presets.tagline: Upscale a clip to 1080p in LTX 2.5, faces held by reference pictures
presets.description: Drop a finished clip in Reference Video 1 and at least one face picture in Face 1 (up to four), plus an optional background plate in the Background slot. Write the prompt LTX style: one paragraph, who, action, place, camera, light. Output is the clip at the chosen tier with its own soundtrack. Measured on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti: 5 s from 864x480 to 1920x1088 in 155 s.

video.displayModel: LTX 2.5 distilled (22B INT8 ConvRot) + latent upsampler + Licon MSR V1

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed by SimpliGen.

extensions.name: ComfyUI-LTX2.5-MSR
extensions.description: Multiple Subject Reference nodes for LTX 2.5. Same pin as SimpliGen's official LTX 2.5 Multi-Reference preset, so usually already installed.

extensions.name: ComfyUI-KJNodes
extensions.description: Provides PathchSageAttentionKJ for SimpliGen's Faster Attention injection (supportsSage). Not used by the graph itself.

requirements.notes: Measured 2026-09-07 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti, engine ComfyUI 0.34.2: 864x480 H3 clip -> 1920x1088 in 155 s for 5 s with one reference face, sigmas 0.85 / 0.725 / 0.4219 / 0 (the A2V pack stage-2 tail). At native pixels the result resolves eye, beard and microphone-mesh detail a Lanczos upscale of the same clip smears (Laplacian variance 24 against 11), and the face matched the source frame for frame with the design sheet in Face 1. Shares every LTX 2.5 file with the A2V and official LTX packs; the only new download is the 1.3 GB MSR V1 LoRA. 1.0.1 adds the Background slot (MSR slot 5) for parity with the official Multi-Reference preset; verified 2026-09-07 with all five slots filled, every slot embedding applied (402 s, but a CPU transcription job was competing for RAM during that run, so treat the number as an upper bound). Duration follows the source clip up to 15 s. Gated HF repo: needs an API key and licence acceptance.
